The '''''Folding Dancer''''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[YKL-37R Nova Courier|Nova Courier]] that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Denner]] of the [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Imperial Storm Squadron]] sent an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to destroy the ''Folding Dancer'' and its escort in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. The pilot carried out the task successfully, destroying the ''Folding Dancer'' in addition to the two [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and four [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] that were escorting it.<ref name="SWG:DtRCS" />
